noted: Noted by hand from the app's code and its README on 19 October 2026, before any AEOM run; not from AEOM's checks or judges. A defect that spans the site is written "*".

defects.what: Every page has its own header: a purple gradient on the home page, a black bar with green links on the products, a yellow banner on the orders, a grey bar on the contact page.
Five fonts, one per page: Comic Sans, Georgia, Helvetica, Courier, Verdana.
The home page has the default look: a purple gradient, decorative emoji, heavily shadowed cards.
The tagline never wraps: the home page scrolls sideways on a phone.
« Découvrir 🎉 » is a div: no pointer, out of the keyboard's reach.
The « Ajouter » buttons show no pointer and do nothing.
The note « Prix TTC… » is light grey on white, below AA contrast.
The sign-in labels are light grey at 11 px.
« ENVOYER » is a div: no pointer, out of the keyboard's reach.
The empty order list says nothing, and its call to /api/orders fails.
The « Aide » link leads to a 500 error.
Asking for help ends on an error page with no way back.
The menu has no link to the orders: they are only reachable from the bottom of the products page.
